min_fire_count_reasoning: Measured 0, against an authored estimate of 2. The estimate counted candidates a proposer would emit; the harness proposes only what pg_parse::Morpher accepted, and the two rows it counted ("ta", "pata") are expect_fail rows with no accepted analysis, so the impossible candidates never reach the filter at all. All 8 witnesses that do reach it are pin-resolvable, and OwnershipPass answers Keep on that before reaching any rejection branch. A nonzero floor here needs a producer that enumerates candidates HC refuses, not a different grammar.
